name: A Supernatural Device

narrative.details:
I must find a way to speak with Anthion Harmon... or more specifically, his ghost!

I know of an engineer with a queer interest in the supernatural.  He claims he can build a machine that allows him to speak with the dead!

The blood you collected was intended for him; travel to Gadgetzan and bring it to him as payment for his services!
narrative.objectives: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Excellent! Just as I was running low!

You say Deliana sent you?
